title: Split lines are priced again by the customer's current tier
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 20.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tier was set, with two labor lines, each with a special-order part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $121.50.
  • Make sure customer A was moved to tier B for work orders after work order 1 was made.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Split Work Order in the work order's three-dot menu.
  3. Tick line 2.
  4. Click Split.
  5. Click the Parts tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • Split Work Order opens with both lines and their part counts.

Step 3:

  • Line 2 is ticked.

Step 4:

  • A new work order with a new number opens for customer A with line 2's labor and part.

Step 5:

  • The moved part reads $108.00, tier B's price ($135.00 × 0.80 = $108.00), with tier B in Priced by.
  • On work order 1 line 1's part still reads $121.50.
